articles.title: Google infuses Gemini generative AI into home gadgets
articles.description: Google introduced new Nest cameras and a doorbell, alongside a redesigned Home app, all centered on integrating its Gemini for Home AI. This platform aims to transform smart home control with conversational commands, detailed notifications, and activity summaries. Many advanced features, however, require a $20/month subscription, and Gemini will also update older devices.
